Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
I think I was to have 6 copies of the [Prince and Page](/book/61) sent to myself - also in the same parcel one of the [Heir of Redclyffe](/book/15). I have seen nothing of them so perhaps they have been forgotten or come to some mischance by the way.
With all new years greetings

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
